description_good_justification: The README opens with what the package does: a set of JavaScript helper functions to check for types: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/README.md#about
interact_justification: The README explains how to install (npm) and use the package, and the contributing guide how to give feedback (GitHub issues) and contribute: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: The contribution process (issues, pull requests, checks, sign-off): https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-code
contribution_requirements_justification: Contribution requirements, including coding style and tests, are in CONTRIBUTING.md: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-code
documentation_basics_justification: Installation and usage with import and require are in the README: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/README.md#installation and https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/README.md#usage
documentation_interface_justification: The README documents every helper, with its signatures, parameters, return value and examples: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/README.md#api
sites_https_justification: The repository and the npm package are served over HTTPS: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are searchable, addressable by URL and open to anyone with a GitHub account: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/issues
english_justification: All documentation is in English, and reports and comments in English are accepted.
maintained_justification: The project is actively maintained: changes are made through pull requests and released when they affect the package: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/releases and https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/commits/main
repo_track_justification: Git records who changed what and when: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Every change is a public commit and pull request between releases, not only the releases themselves.
version_unique_justification: Every release has a unique version, tagged as <version>: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/tags
version_semver_justification: Semantic Versioning; the public API only breaks in a major release: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
version_tags_justification: Each release is tagged in git: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/tags
release_notes_justification: A CHANGELOG.md generated from conventional commits, also published as GitHub release notes: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release has fixed a publicly known vulnerability in the published package. Such a fix would be listed in the release notes and a GitHub security advisory.
report_tracker_justification: Issues are tracked on GitHub: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/issues
report_responses_justification: Every issue is assigned to the maintainer when it is opened, and bug reports are answered in their issue: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/issues
enhancement_responses_justification: Every issue is assigned to the maintainer when it is opened, and enhancement requests are answered in their issue: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/issues
report_archive_justification: All issues and pull requests stay public and searchable on GitHub: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports through GitHub private vulnerability reporting or by email: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: Reports are acknowledged within 7 days, as the security policy says: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
build_justification: npm run build builds the ES module, CommonJS and type declarations with rollup: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#development
build_common_tools_justification: npm, rollup and the TypeScript compiler.
build_floss_tools_justification: npm, Node.js, rollup and TypeScript are all FLOSS.
test_justification: A node:test suite, run with npm test, and a packaging check (npm run check:pack) that installs the packed package, calls the helpers from every entry point on Node 24 and Node 22.0.0, and runs the README examples: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
test_invocation_justification: npm test, the standard way to run tests in an npm project.
test_most_justification: The source is at 100% of lines, functions and branches, and test:ci fails below 100% of any of them. Coverage is uploaded to Codecov from every CI run.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The Checks workflow lints, type-checks, builds, packs and tests every pull request and every push to main: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
test_policy_justification: New functionality must come with tests and bug fixes with a regression test: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
tests_are_added_justification: Changes come with tests: every bug fix in the last six months added a regression test or a CI check (#120, #126, #172), and pull requests must keep coverage at 100%: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
tests_documented_added_justification: The tests policy is part of the instructions for contributing code: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
warnings_justification: TypeScript runs in strict mode, and ESLint (typescript-eslint, stylistic and Prettier rules) runs on every file, Markdown and tests included.
warnings_fixed_justification: Lint has no errors and no warnings, and TypeScript has no errors.
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript runs with strict: true, and type errors and lint errors fail the Checks workflow.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer knows how to design secure software. The principles applied: helpers with no side effects and no dynamic code, no runtime dependencies (checked in CI), least-privilege CI tokens, pinned Actions, and releases with provenance. What the package guarantees and does not: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainer knows the common errors for this kind of software: injection and dynamic code (none: no eval or code loading), supply chain (no runtime dependencies, checked in CI; locked and reviewed development dependencies; pinned Actions), and hostile input (documented: forged prototypes and values that throw): https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#assurance-case
crypto_published_justification: The package implements and calls no cryptography, and does no network access: each helper takes one value and returns a boolean. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations

crypto_random_justification: The package implements and calls no cryptography, and does no network access: each helper takes one value and returns a boolean. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
delivery_mitm_justification: The package is delivered by npm over HTTPS with Sigstore-signed provenance, and the repository by GitHub over HTTPS.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes are fetched over HTTP; npm verifies package integrity from the registry metadata over HTTPS.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: The published package has no runtime dependencies and no known vulnerabilities (npm audit --omit=dev runs before every release). Development tooling alerts are fixed as described in the security policy: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been found in the published package.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials are in the repository; GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (GitHub default setup) analyses every pull request and push to main, and ESLint runs on every pull request.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL analyses the JavaScript/TypeScript code and the GitHub Actions workflows on every push to main and every pull request, and the ruleset on main requires its results, with no errors and no high or critical security alerts, before merging: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL findings are fixed before merging: the ruleset on main blocks merging while CodeQL reports an error or a high or critical security alert.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every pull request and every push to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Property-based tests with fast-check check rules that hold for every value on 1000 generated values each, on every pull request and push to main: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/src/__tests__/properties.ts
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: All software is TypeScript on JavaScript runtimes, which are memory-safe; there is no C, C++ or other memory-unsafe code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: No run-time assertions: the helpers take any value and return a boolean by design.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: The property-based tests run in CI on every pull request, and a failure blocks merging, so what they find is fixed before it is merged.
achieve_passing_justification: The project has the passing badge: https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/15896
dco_justification: Every commit must be signed off under the Developer Certificate of Origin, and the DCO check is required on every pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin
governance_justification: A maintainer-led model, with how decisions are made in public: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#model
code_of_conduct_justification: The Contributor Covenant, in the standard location: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
roles_responsibilities_justification: The maintainer and contributor roles, who holds them and their responsibilities: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles
access_continuity_justification: Only the maintainer has admin access to the repository and owns the npm package, so the project could not continue under its own name without them. This is documented, and a second maintainer is on the roadmap: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity
bus_factor_justification: The bus factor is 1: one maintainer. A second maintainer is on the roadmap: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
documentation_roadmap_justification: What the project intends to do and not do from October 2026 to October 2027: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
documentation_architecture_justification: How the source, build, package, tests, scripts and workflows fit together: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#architecture
documentation_security_justification: What users can and cannot rely on: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
documentation_quick_start_justification: Installing and calling the helpers takes two steps: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/README.md#installation and https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/README.md#usage
documentation_current_justification: Every README example is run against the packed package in CI, and its commented results checked, so the documentation must match the current code to pass: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
documentation_achievements_justification: The README links the OpenSSF Best Practices and Scorecard badges: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/README.md
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: The project produces a library with no user interface; its documentation is Markdown rendered by GitHub and npm.
internationalization_justification: The software has no user-facing text: each helper takes a value and returns a boolean.
sites_password_security_justification: The project sites are GitHub and npm; the project itself stores no passwords.
maintenance_or_update_justification: Semantic Versioning: upgrading within a major never breaks code, the current major is supported as a whole, and breaking changes come with an upgrading guide: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability reports were resolved in the last 12 months. Reporters are credited in the advisory and release notes unless they ask to stay anonymous: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: The documented process, from acknowledgement to disclosure and credit: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
coding_standards_justification: ESLint with eslint-config-phun-ky, Prettier formatting and TypeScript in strict mode, required for every contribution: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-style
coding_standards_enforced_justification: npm run style:lint and npm run typecheck run on every pull request in the required check, so a contribution that breaks the style can not be merged: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
build_standard_variables_justification: The project builds no native binaries; it is JavaScript bundled with rollup.
build_preserve_debug_justification: The builds are minified, but each ships a source map that points at the published TypeScript source, so debugging information is kept.
build_non_recursive_justification: One rollup configuration builds everything from src/main.ts; nothing builds subdirectories recursively.
build_repeatable_justification: Building the same commit twice gives byte-identical dist output (checked with diff -r); the build embeds no timestamps.
installation_common_justification: Installed and removed with npm: npm install @phun-ky/typeof and npm uninstall @phun-ky/typeof.
installation_standard_variables_justific: The package has no installation system of its own; npm decides where it is installed.
installation_development_quick_justifica: npm ci installs everything needed to build, test and check the package: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#development
external_dependencies_justification: package.json lists the dependencies (there are no runtime ones), and package-lock.json locks every version: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/package.json
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot alerts and security updates, dependency review on every pull request, and npm audit before every release: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Every reused component comes from npm through package.json and is updated by Dependabot; nothing is copied into the repository.
interfaces_current_justification: The code uses current JavaScript and Node.js APIs, with TypeScript in strict mode; no deprecated APIs are used.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: The Checks workflow runs the whole test suite on every pull request and push to main, and reports success or failure on each: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
regression_tests_added50_justification: All three bug fixes in the last six months added a regression test or a CI check: #120, #126 and #172.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: Coverage is 100% of lines, branches and functions, measured by the Node.js test runner, and test:ci fails below 100%.
test_policy_mandated_justification: New functionality must come with tests, and bug fixes with a regression test: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests

signed_releases_justification: Every release on npm carries a Sigstore-signed provenance attestation, verified with npm audit signatures: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases
version_tags_signed_justification: Release tags are created by release-it in GitHub Actions and are not signed.
input_validation_justification: The helpers accept any value by design: there are no invalid inputs to reject, only values that are or are not of a type.
hardening_justification: TypeScript in strict mode, no dynamic code, no runtime dependencies, module-private data that is not exported, read-only workflow tokens and pinned Actions: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#assurance-case
assurance_case_justification: Threat model, trust boundaries, secure design principles and the common weaknesses countered: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#assurance-case
osps_ac_01_01_justification: Waiting for the maintainer to confirm that two-factor authentication is on for the GitHub account that administers the repository.
osps_ac_02_01_justification: Collaborators on this repository are added only by a manual invitation from the maintainer, and get the lowest role that lets them do the work: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_ac_03_01_justification: A ruleset on main requires a pull request with passing checks for every change. Only the repository admin can bypass it, which the release workflow needs to push its release commit and tag.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: A ruleset on main forbids deleting the branch and force pushes, with no bypass.
osps_br_01_01_justification: Workflows pass untrusted values such as the actor through environment variables, never into scripts; the only pull_request_target workflow, the labeler, does not check out or run pull request code.
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull requests run with read-only tokens and without secrets for forks; the only pull_request_target workflow, the labeler, does not check out or run pull request code.
osps_br_03_01_justification: Every official channel is served over HTTPS: the repository, issues and npm package: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof
osps_br_03_02_justification: The package is distributed through npm over HTTPS with Sigstore-signed provenance: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub secret scanning with push protection blocks commits that contain a secret: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
osps_do_01_01_justification: The README documents installation, usage and every helper: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/README.md#api
osps_gv_02_01_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are open to anyone for proposals and questions: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/issues
osps_le_02_02_justification: The released package is MIT-licensed, the same licence as the source.
osps_le_03_01_justification: The licence is in the LICENSE file: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_03_02_justification: Every published npm package includes the LICENSE file; check:pack fails a package without it.
osps_qa_01_01_justification: The repository is public at a static URL: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof
osps_qa_01_02_justification: Git records every change, who made it and when, publicly: https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/commits/main
osps_qa_02_01_justification: package.json lists the direct dependencies (there are no runtime ones): https://github.com/phun-ky/typeof/blob/main/package.json
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The project has a single repository.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: The built files (dist) are not committed; they are built in CI and published to npm.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The repository contains only text files: source, tests, scripts, configuration and documentation.
